Next, when heartbeat loss persists for a certain time or more, the TDSS transitions from limited communication to communication blackout mode. Because integrated command is impossible, the TDSS activates the local sensor-based survival loop, and the three reconnaissance drones transmit drone emergency broadcast messages.
